segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Remind me, Trevor ... how long is the presentation?

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Dr White said three per hour.

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: So about twenty minutes?

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Well ... it'll be fifteen minutes per presentation.

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: And five minutes for questions.

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: And is this one going to be assessed?

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: No .. . not this time round ... because it's the first one ... you know.

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Good news.

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Well, Trevor, what are we going to include?

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Well . .. Do you think we ought to give some historical background?

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Oh no .. . definitely not ... we won't have time!

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: OK ... but I think we ought to say something about the geographical location . . . cos not a lot of people know where the islands are ...

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Yes . . . OK ... I'll take notes, shall I?

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Yeah, that'll be a help ...

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: So . .. geographical location ...

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Then we ought to give an overview of the whole education system.

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Shouldn't we say something about the economy ... you know agricultural produce ... minerals and so forth?

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Well .. . Or White said we shouldn't go into that sort of detail.

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: But it's pretty important when you think about it ... you know because it does influence the education system . . .

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Look .. . let's think about that one later shall we? Let's see how we're doing for time ...

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: OK ... so .. . general overview of education

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Of course ... and then the role of English language . . .

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Nope ... that goes in the Language Policy Seminar .. . don't you remember?

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Are you sure?

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Positive.

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: All right . . . so those are the topics we're going to be ... to be covering . . .

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: We need to think about what to prepare . . . Dr White said he wanted us to use plenty of visuals and things and we might as well try them out when we're not being assessed . ..

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Well, the most important thing is the overhead projector . . .

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: No problem . .. we'll get that from the media room . . . must remember to book it . . .

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Well ... we'll need a map of course.

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Probably two ... one of the islands . .. large scale.

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: And one of West Africa.

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Well, the West African one is no problem .. . There's one in the Resources Room.

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Oh yeah, of course, the resources room; the islands are going to be more of a problem.

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Tell you what ... there's a very clear map of Santiago in that tourist brochure I showed you last week. Don't you remember it?

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Oh yeah .. . that's right; we can just use the tourist brochure.

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: We also need statistics .. . on several different things.

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Literacy rates.

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Yes, and school places.

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: How about the encyclopaedia?

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Nah . . . not up-to-date enough!

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Mmm . .. why don't we call the embassy?

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Oh .. . someone's enthusiastic!

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Well ... if something's worth doing . ..

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: I know . . . it's worth doing well . . . OK.

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: We can find out statistics on school places from them as well.

segments.speaker: JULIE
segments.en: Might as well.

segments.speaker: TREVOR
segments.en: Look, Julie, it's almost time for our tutorials .. . we can meet again on Monday . .. but we need to prepare some stuff before then ...
